stories.title: Persist one durable agent session
stories.user_story: As the Telegram owner, I want Shiori to retain the conversation across turns and restarts, so that follow-up answers keep their meaning.
stories.why_now: This is the walking skeleton and replaces the six-turn manual replay with the chosen Agents SDK session strategy.
in_scope: Implement an application-owned Agents SDK session backed by encrypted Supabase persistence.
Store SDK-compatible conversation items, relevant callback choices, pending questions, compaction checkpoints, and opaque history cursors.
Use the same session across bounded owner turns and service restarts while keeping provider storage disabled.
Provide owner reset/forget semantics without deleting commitments or product audit events.

acceptance_criteria.given: an owner conversation with more than six turns
acceptance_criteria.then: the durable session remains coherent without deleting the seventh or older required turn.

acceptance_criteria.given: a persisted active session
acceptance_criteria.then: the next owner message continues through the same session.

acceptance_criteria.given: older history outside the working context
acceptance_criteria.when: history is requested with its opaque cursor
acceptance_criteria.then: a bounded non-duplicated page is returned with an accurate continuation cursor.

acceptance_criteria.given: persisted conversation and paused state
acceptance_criteria.then: content is application-encrypted and provider storage remains disabled.

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated owner reset or forget request
acceptance_criteria.then: conversation context is closed or deleted without deleting authoritative commitments or events.

verification.done_when: A reviewer can restart the service, continue a conversation beyond six turns, page older context, and verify encrypted application-owned storage.

squad.rationale: The story is a persistence and SDK lifecycle seam and is best owned end-to-end by one engineer before integrated QA.

stories.title: Unify conversational focus and tools
stories.user_story: As the owner, I want every typed reply to stay with the conversation I am having, so that I can answer naturally or begin another promise without losing work.
stories.why_now: The durable session becomes useful only when all text uses one orchestrator with authoritative focus and context.
in_scope: Route every typed Telegram message through one conversational agent.
Expose authoritative pending interaction, callback choice, draft, commitment, work-session, and outcome context.
Add bounded typed history and product read tools.
Allow multiple drafts with one exact focused entity per turn.
Ask for clarification without mutation when an entity reference is ambiguous.
Let the agent author ordinary answers and follow-up questions.

acceptance_criteria.given: a focused draft awaiting a preparation or timing answer
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner supplies that answer as text
acceptance_criteria.then: the unified agent advances the same exact draft.

acceptance_criteria.given: one existing draft
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner clearly starts a separate promise
acceptance_criteria.then: a second draft is created and the first is not overwritten.

acceptance_criteria.given: two plausible target entities
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner uses an ambiguous reference
acceptance_criteria.then: the agent asks which entity is intended and no mutation occurs.

acceptance_criteria.given: an ordinary question during an active commitment conversation
acceptance_criteria.then: the agent answers naturally and preserves the current focus and product state.

acceptance_criteria.given: a callback-generated question and owner choice
acceptance_criteria.then: both are available in structured conversational context.

verification.done_when: A reviewer can continue preparation, start a second draft, resolve ambiguity, and ask an ordinary question through the same agent without unintended mutation.

squad.rationale: One engineer should own the text-routing and tool-context seam to avoid reintroducing competing conversational flows.

stories.title: Approve creation and commitment edits
stories.user_story: As the owner, I want to approve a new promise or a correction to an existing one, so that Shiori changes exactly what I reviewed.
stories.why_now: The unified agent needs consequential tools that pause and resume the same run rather than launching a disconnected execution conversation.
in_scope: Make creation and material commitment edits exact approval-gated tools in the conversational run.
Resume the same encrypted paused run after a bound owner approval.
Support definition, target, preparation, and next-work-session edits where the current commitment lifecycle permits.
Recheck Calendar for relevant time changes and atomically replace obsolete unsent schedules.
Preserve version, stale-action, replay, and idempotency guarantees.

acceptance_criteria.given: a complete exact draft
acceptance_criteria.then: the same run pauses, the owner sees an application-owned preview, and nothing consequential exists before approval.

acceptance_criteria.given: an approved exact creation interruption
acceptance_criteria.then: one commitment and its correct schedules and events are created atomically.

acceptance_criteria.given: an active commitment and an owner-requested material correction
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner approves the exact current version
acceptance_criteria.then: the commitment and affected unsent schedules update atomically with an append-only change event.

acceptance_criteria.given: a time-changing edit that requires Calendar validation
acceptance_criteria.then: availability is rechecked and conflict or unverified-save policy is applied before mutation.

acceptance_criteria.given: a rejected, stale, replayed, mismatched, or interrupted approval
acceptance_criteria.then: it cannot duplicate or mutate a different entity or version.

commands: npm run test --workspace @shiori/server -- src/agent src/commitments src/work-sessions
verification.done_when: A reviewer can approve one exact creation and one exact edit, observe correct schedules and events, and prove all stale and replay cases are harmless.

squad.rationale: The story combines SDK approval authority with transactional domain updates and needs one engineer accountable for the complete boundary.

stories.title: Complete flexible preparation conversations
stories.user_story: As the owner, I want to describe preparation time and constraints naturally, so that Shiori proposes a realistic work session without forcing fixed-form answers.
stories.why_now: This closes the exact production failure that motivated the slice and proves the unified agent across the full preparation path.
in_scope: Accept bounded positive preparation durations beyond the old four-value enum.
Extract timing constraints and owner-selected times through the agent.
Preserve the mandatory preparation decision and one-next-session rule.
Generate natural follow-up questions and controlled Calendar warnings.
Complete free, busy, owner-choice, and no-preparation paths.
out_of_scope: Several future work sessions planned in advance.
Automatic behavioral scheduling or Calendar writes.

acceptance_criteria.given: a newly complete promise
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner has not supplied a preparation decision
acceptance_criteria.then: the agent asks whether preparation is needed while preserving the exact draft.

acceptance_criteria.given: the owner supplies a supported bounded duration such as 45 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: the draft records that duration without forcing one of the previous four values.

acceptance_criteria.given: the agent asks for timing constraints
acceptance_criteria.then: the same focused draft advances to sanitized availability or an exact owner-time question.

acceptance_criteria.given: free, conflicting, unavailable, and Calendar-failure results
acceptance_criteria.then: the owner receives correct choices and controlled warnings without losing conversation focus.

acceptance_criteria.given: the owner declines preparation
acceptance_criteria.then: the same draft proceeds directly to its exact creation approval.

commands: npm run test --workspace @shiori/server -- src/agent src/work-sessions src/telegram
verification.done_when: A reviewer can complete the preparation flow with natural constraints and a 45-minute duration through the same agent without a routing fallback.

squad.rationale: This is an end-to-end agent and deterministic work-session integration best implemented as one vertical concern.

stories.title: Release the durable conversational agent
stories.user_story: As the owner, I want the deployed Telegram agent to retain context and execute only approved changes, so that I can trust it in real use.
stories.why_now: The slice is complete only when the integrated architecture survives regression, restart, replay, and real deployed use.
in_scope: Run consolidated story-level QA and the full repository gate.
Apply additive migrations to the configured Supabase environment.
Push the current branch and deploy the dedicated Railway service.
Verify create, prepare, approve, correct, edit, restart, replay, ordinary-question, and privacy scenarios.
Record sanitized evidence and close the slice state.
out_of_scope: New product capability discovered during release verification.
Weakening an acceptance criterion to pass.
Recording secrets or unrelated owner conversation content.

acceptance_criteria.given: the integrated implementation
acceptance_criteria.then: all typechecks, tests, builds, and isolated browser verification pass.

acceptance_criteria.given: the configured Supabase and Railway service
acceptance_criteria.when: migrations and the current branch are deployed
acceptance_criteria.then: the deployment becomes healthy without losing existing commitments, schedules, or Slice 01 behavior.

acceptance_criteria.given: a real owner Telegram conversation
acceptance_criteria.when: the representative create, preparation, correction, edit, restart, and replay flow runs
acceptance_criteria.then: conversation continuity and exact approval behavior match this slice.

acceptance_criteria.given: stored session, provider configuration, logs, and evidence
acceptance_criteria.then: provider storage is disabled and no secret, decrypted transcript, or unrelated Calendar content is exposed.

verification.done_when: A reviewer can reproduce the full gate and see a healthy deployed service pass the real owner conversation, approval, restart, replay, and privacy checks.

squad.rationale: Consolidated verification needs independent acceptance review plus an engineer available for evidence-backed fixes.
